name: sweep
description: Liquidity Sweep: a candle wicks under the last swing low (taking the stops there) and closes back above it bullish. Buys the reclaim, stop under the wick, target a set reward-to-risk.
author: bb-cli

swing.describe: candles on each side that make a swing low

minWick.describe: wick must go at least this many ATRs below the swing low

slAtr.describe: stop this many ATRs under the wick
